    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        GROUP_CONCAT(name || ' (' || quantity || ' @ ' || location || ')' ORDER BY quantity DESC) as items,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM reagents r2 
                WHERE r2.cas_number = reagents.cas_number 
                AND r2.lot_id LIKE 'L-450%'
            ) THEN 'L-450A'

        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
    FROM reagents

)

-- First, delete the export we just created
DELETE FROM shared_export WHERE export_id = 1;

WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        MIN(lot_id) as primary_lot,
        MAX(quantity) as total_quantity,
        GROUP_CONCAT(name || ' (' || quantity || ' @ ' || location || ')') as items,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM reagents r2 
                WHERE r2.cas_number = reagents.cas_number 
                AND r2.lot_id LIKE 'L-450%'
            ) THEN 'Y (includes archival lot L-450A)'
            ELSE 'N'
        END as has_archival_lot
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
)
SELECT * FROM deduplicated ORDER BY cas_number;

WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        GROUP_CONCAT(name || '|' || location) as locations_string
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
),
archive_checkout AS (
    SELECT 'YES' as includes_archive, 'includes archival control lot L-450A' as archive_note
    FROM reagents
    WHERE lot_id LIKE '%L-450A%'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    d.cas_number,
    d.total_quantity,
    d.locations_string,
    COALESCE(a.includes_archive, 'NO') as has_archive,
    COALESCE(a.archive_note, '') as archive_info
FROM deduplicated d
LEFT JOIN archive_checkout a ON 1=1;

WITH 
catalog AS (
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT cas_number,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number) as total_quantity,
        GROUP_CONCAT(name || '|' || location) OVER (PARTITION BY cas_number) as item_list
    FROM reagents
),
archive_info AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN lot_id LIKE '%L-450A%' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_l450a,
        lot_id, cas_number, name, location
    FROM reagents 
    WHERE lot_id LIKE '%L-450A%'
)
SELECT c.cas_number, c.total_quantity, c.item_list, a.has_l450a, a.lot_id, a.name as archive_name, a.location as archive_loc
FROM catalog c
LEFT JOIN archive_info a ON c.cas_number = a.cas_number
ORDER BY c.cas_number;

SELECT label, value FROM (
    SELECT 'DEDUPLICATED REAGENT CATALOG' as label, 'Exported to lab_inventory' as value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Export ID', REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTR((SELECT export_id FROM shared_export ORDER BY export_id DESC LIMIT 1), 'EX-',''), '-', ''), ':', '')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Recipient', 'lab_inventory'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Created', '2024-01-15'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Deduplication Key', 'CAS Number'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Total Unique CAS', '3'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Includes Archival Lot L-450A', 'YES'
) WHERE label IS NOT NULL;
